facts.en: Completed a construction stores certificate at Fictional Flintmeadow Training Centre in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构燧草培训中心完成施工物料库证书课程。

facts.en: Paid materials assistant at Fictional Hearthstone Masonry Yard from 2020-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2020-02 至 2026-08 在虚构炉石砌筑料场任有薪材料助理。

facts.en: Matched supplier labels to approved material codes and marked the delivery date on the yard register.
facts.zh: 将供应商标签与获批材料代码匹配，并在料场登记表上标注到货日期。

facts.en: Prepared small fittings and packaging materials for job bundles using the foreman’s pick list.
facts.zh: 依据工头拣货单，为工单配料包准备小型配件及包装材料。

facts.en: Checked visible package damage and reported unidentified stone bundles before they were assigned a storage location.
facts.zh: 在分配存放位置前检查可见包装损坏，并报告无法识别的石材捆包。

facts.en: A qualified lifting team moved large stone loads; the candidate documented their destinations from the foreman’s instructions.
facts.zh: 由合资格吊装团队搬运大型石材货物；候选人依据工头指示记录其目的位置。

facts.en: The foreman specified stone grade, cutting dimensions and load placement.
facts.zh: 工头指定石材等级、切割尺寸及货物放置位置。

facts.en: Helped relabel a small-fittings shelf in 2024-10 with the yard purchaser.
facts.zh: 2024-10 与料场采购员共同协助为小型配件货架重新贴标签。

facts.en: Personally checked 54 shelf codes against the supplier catalogue; the purchaser approved replacement product codes.
facts.zh: 个人依据供应商目录核对 54 个货架代码；替代产品代码由采购员批准。

facts.en: The shelf check found 6 old codes that no longer appeared in the current catalogue; no value for the affected stock was recorded.
facts.zh: 该货架检查发现 6 个旧代码已不在现行目录中；未记录受影响库存的价值。

facts.en: Uses delivery-note references, shelf-code lists and spreadsheet filters.
facts.zh: 使用送货单编号、货架代码清单及电子表格筛选。

facts.en: Prepared a daily list of unfilled pick requests and deliveries awaiting code confirmation.
facts.zh: 每天准备未完成拣货请求及等待代码确认到货的清单。

facts.en: Completed internal yard-access and manual-handling orientation in 2020-02; no lifting-equipment licence was issued.
facts.zh: 2020-02 完成内部料场出入及人工搬运入门培训；未颁发起重设备操作执照。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Birchbrick Model Village Group from 2021-05 to 2024-09.
facts.zh: 2021-05 至 2024-09 在虚构桦砖模型村团体做志愿者。

facts.en: At that group, sorted donated model-building pieces by size and prepared labeled kits for supervised public workshops.
facts.zh: 在该团体按尺寸整理捐赠模型建筑零件，并为受监督的公众工作坊准备有标签套件。

facts.en: The workshops used lightweight model materials, not structural masonry.
facts.zh: 这些工作坊使用轻质模型材料，而非结构性砌筑材料。

facts.en: Made a personal cardboard arch model in 2023 to explore decorative patterns; no engineering load test was performed.
facts.zh: 2023 年制作个人纸板拱模型以探索装饰图案；未进行工程荷载测试。
爱好素描想象中的庭院布局。

facts.en: Handed open delivery discrepancies to the next shift with the related document references.
facts.zh: 将未解决的到货差异连同相关文件编号交接给下一班。
